tasks.subject: Task 1: Create multiplexing-source.lib.tengo
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Lean resolver mirroring Miltenyi's `multiplexing-source.lib.tengo` but returning only `{sampleId → barcodeValue}`. Both upstream shapes (new multiplexingRules column + legacy Barcode ID metadata) supported. Failure modes surface explicit messages.

**Files:**
- Create: `workflow/src/multiplexing-source.lib.tengo`
- Create: `workflow/src/test/multiplexing-source.test.tpl.tengo`
- Create: `workflow/src/test/multiplexing-source.test.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- `addSelectors(bundleBuilder)` adds three selectors keyed `multiplexingRules`, `legacyLinker`, `legacyBarcodeId`
- `resolve(bundle)` returns `{ok: true, sampleBarcodes, traceSource}` when rules column resolves with single tag + single alt
- `resolve(bundle)` returns `{ok: true, sampleBarcodes, traceSource}` when only the legacy `Barcode ID` metadata col resolves
- `resolve(bundle)` returns `{ok: false, message}` for: missing both shapes; multi-alt cells; multi-tag column (v1 limitation)
- Tengo unit test passes for all five cases

**Verify:** `cd workflow && rtk pnpm run test` → all multiplexing-source tests pass

**Steps:**
1. Write failing test template + .ts driver (5 test cases)
2. Run tests — confirm fail with "not found"
3. Implement the lib with addSelectors + resolve + parseRulesColumn + parseLegacyColumn helpers
4. Run tests — confirm pass
5. Commit

```json:metadata
{"files": ["workflow/src/multiplexing-source.lib.tengo", "workflow/src/test/multiplexing-source.test.tpl.tengo", "workflow/src/test/multiplexing-source.test.ts"], "verifyCommand": "cd /Users/paulnewling/Desktop/Code/mictx/worktrees/tcr-disco/fix-sdk-update/workflow && pnpm run test", "acceptanceCriteria": ["addSelectors adds 3 selectors", "resolve returns ok:true for rules+legacy cases", "resolve rejects multi-tag/multi-alt with message", "All 5 test cases pass"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Synthesize Barcode ID column in wf.body
tasks.description:
**Goal:** When the resolver succeeds and no legacy Barcode ID metadata column already exists, inject a synthetic Barcode ID column into the metadata TSV so find-pairs.R finds sample_id_col regardless of upstream shape.

**Files:**
- Modify: `workflow/src/main.tpl.tengo` (around lines 289–296)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- If `multiplexingSource.resolve(columns)` returns `ok:true` AND no `allMetadata` column carries label "Barcode ID", a synthetic PColumn is added to `metadataTable` with header "Barcode ID"
- If a "Barcode ID" labelled column is already present, synthetic is NOT added (avoids duplicate)
- If resolver returns `ok:false`, metadataTable is built unchanged (preserves current fallback UX)
- Workflow builds; NewMiltenyi run produces metadata.tsv with Barcode ID col (verified Task 5); OldMiltenyi run produces identical metadata.tsv to baseline

**Verify:** `cd workflow && rtk pnpm run build:dev` exit 0

**Steps:**
1. Read current state of metadata-table region (lines 289–296)
2. Replace with dual-path version (tracks `legacyBarcodeColPresent` while iterating allMetadata; synthesizes after)
3. Build — if tsvFileBuilder.add rejects the inline stub, fall back to publishing via pframes.pFrameBuilder first
4. Commit

```json:metadata
{"files": ["workflow/src/main.tpl.tengo"], "verifyCommand": "cd /Users/paulnewling/Desktop/Code/mictx/worktrees/tcr-disco/fix-sdk-update/workflow && pnpm run build:dev", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Synthetic column injected when resolver ok and no legacy col present", "Skip when legacy Barcode ID col already present", "build:dev succeeds"]}
```
